title: NormalizedTowerCommonLisseStrata
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and M a normalized adic tower [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Suppose all cohomology sheaves of its first positive level are intrinsically constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], and every level has cohomology in a common interval [a,b] with a <= b. There is a finite locally closed scheme stratification [def-constructible-stratification] such that on each stratum every cohomology sheaf of every level, after actual derived inverse image and canonical constant-coefficient scalar restriction, is relatively finite lisse. No common local complex or simultaneous normalization-compatible trivialization is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the proved native_common_strata construction to the first quotient after fixed-scalar restriction. It supplies one native finite-lisse sieve on every stratum and cohomological degree in the common interval. Apply normalizedTower_lisse_of_native_strata to these sieves; its nilpotent reduction argument propagates the models through all normalized quotients and transports them through the canonical inverse-image coefficient maps.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedTower_common_lisse_strata
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (hconstructible : ∀ q : ℤ,
      @IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1)) _
        (d.quotientFinite 0)
        ((pbcRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d 0).hom).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level 0))))
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbounded : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n))) :
    ∃ S : Stratification X, ∀ (i : Fin S.n) (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule (S.immersion i) (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (S.immersion i)).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback (S.immersion i)
                ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))
